digest.component_or_area: bridge fsck scan and offline store auditing
propositions: Retire phantom SYNC-dependent checks (orphaned, duplicates, stale) that short-circuit on tickets without SYNC events and never populate output cells.
Detect unknown event types offline from refs/heads/tickets using git grep and git show without requiring a tickets checkout, rejecting matches outside top-level event_type.
Add store_integrity audit verifying that every confirmed forward binding has a non-empty Jira key and matching reverse entry, and every reverse entry points to a confirmed binding with the same key.

Fail closed with RebarError(returncode=2) and CLI exit 2 on Git failures (missing executable, missing ref, malformed output, exit >=2, read/parse failure); keep unknown_event_types as informational and only store_integrity findings as gating.
Retain BRIDGE_ALERT event emission, reducer integration, bridge_state JSONL channel, and bridge-status compatibility entrypoint unchanged.
Update all consumers (CLI, library, MCP model, JSON schema, generated docs, test contracts, release notes) to require unknown_event_types, binding_drift, and store_integrity in the output contract.
